integrity: Analytical proof plus finite exact-rational checks and fixed-seed simulations; independent scientific validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed unit lattice, exactly computed pre-round affine updates, independent uniforms, 0<theta<1 and 0<r<1; nondegenerate negative-branch limit excludes 2theta integer. Not a floating-point exponent/overflow model; no convergence rates or extension to nonlinear operators is proved.
title: A sign-reversal Gaussian limit for unbiased lattice rounding
